title: The Subscription Trap Nobody Escapes Until Now
description:
One website keeps a running list of free and open source alternatives to nearly every paid tool you subscribe to, including Claude Code, Cursor, Photoshop, Canva and Notion. Search what you pay for, get the free replacement. The free guide below has a full swap chart with real prices, what you give up on each swap, and the exact install steps.

Get the full guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-Hi_67RIJFh_qvffhjx8M_cqpZYB5tStU0KJknKfeGI/edit?usp=sharing

#Shorts #OpenSource #AITools
